## Think About It

1. Where does the pine tree stand? (On a hill.) 2. What happens when the wind blows? (The tree bends and sways.) 3. Who lives in the tree? (A bird and a mouse.) 4. Find a silent E word in the story. (pine, tree, time, wide, soft, green, tall, branches, north, side, safe, day, breaks, brave, comes, still, blue, fine.)
